copies.description: Copies in the collection with this barcode.

barcode.description: UPC or EAN from the box.

oneOf.description:
The bundle copy this copy came in. Its status, format, device, store,
condition, platform and region follow that copy.

contents.description: Copies of other games that came in this one, by title.

estimated_value.description: Decimal text: what an owned copy would sell for now.

price.description: Decimal text such as `59.99`: paid for an owned copy, expected for a wanted one.

tags.description: Home Assistant tags that start playing this copy, oldest first.

barcode.description: UPC or EAN; spaces and hyphens are ignored.

estimated_value.description: Decimal text: what an owned copy would sell for now; needs `estimated_currency`.

oneOf.description:
`wanted` puts the copy on the wishlist. Left out, a new copy is owned
and an existing one keeps its status.

CopyRow.description: One copy in the copies view, with its release and game.

bundle_copy_id.description: The bundle copy this copy came in.

cover_path.description: The release cover, else the game's. Relative to the covers URL.

CopySource.description: Where a copy came from: added in the app, or by a CSV import.

copy_count.description: Copies assigned to this device, of any status.

platform_ids.description: Platforms this device plays, in platform list order.

slug.description: Names the device in library links.

Names it in library links. Blank makes one from the name for a new
one and keeps the current one on update.

copies.description: In platform list order, then region.

ErrorBody.description:
Error body. `code` is a stable key the UI translates; it never carries
display text. `field` names the input field at fault, when there is one.

FileIssue.description: A problem with the file as a whole; no rows are read when there is one.

names.description: Other names the game goes by, which the library search also matches.

releases.description: In platform list order, then region.

sessions.description: Latest first; the first is when the game was last played.

oneOf.description: The last person to edit the game itself; copies record their own.

versions.description: Games in the collection that IGDB names as another version of this one, by title.

label_ids.description: Left out, the current labels stay. At most 50.

names.description: Other names to search by. Left out, the current ones stay.

from_igdb.description: From IGDB, which replaces them on a refresh, or added by hand.

platforms.description: Platforms with owned copies, or wanted ones on the wishlist, in platform list order.

relation.description: What that game is to this one.

HeaderMatch.description:
How a header was read. `column` is empty for headers that match nothing
or repeat a column an earlier header took.

Image.description: A JPEG, PNG or WebP image, at most 10 MB and 100 megapixels.

oneOf.description: Set when the file cannot be read at all; everything else but the headers is then empty.

headers.description: How each header of the file was read, in file order.

unlinked_games.description: Games in the whole collection, after the import, with no IGDB link.

slug.description: Names the label in library links.

Names it in library links. Blank makes one from the name for a new
one and keeps the current one on update.

overwrite.description:
Replace title, summary, game modes, player counts and release titles
and dates with IGDB's where IGDB has them. Otherwise only empty ones are filled.

score.description: How close the names are, 0 to 100.

platforms.description: Platforms of the game's copies, in platform list order.

can_track_progress.description: May change play status and last played.

managers_configured.description: False until the app options name a manager; until then nobody can change anything.

MissingField.description: A detail a game can lack. Copy details count when any owned copy lacks them.

Person.description: Who added or last changed something.

name.description: Display name, else username; `None` when Home Assistant sent neither.

oneOf.description: `None` for platforms added by hand without one.

custom.description:
Added by hand or by an import rather than shipped with the app. Only
these can be deleted.

game_count.description: Games with a release on this platform.

owned_game_count.description: Games with an owned copy on this platform.

wanted_game_count.description: Games with a wishlist copy on this platform.

slug.description:
Names it in library links. Blank makes one from the name for a new
one and keeps the current one on update.

ids.description: Every platform id, once, in the new order.

copy_id.description: The owned copy played, when known.

label.description: `null` for a built-in status that keeps its default name.
Blank resets a built-in status to its default name.

play_status.description: A play status key; `null` clears it.

keys.description: Every status key, in the new order.

title.description:
As the database lists it, often with the platform, such as
"Super Mario Odyssey - Nintendo Switch".

Region.description: Release region, matching IGDB's release regions. `ww` also covers region-free.

cover_path.description: This release's own cover, relative to the covers URL. The game's cover applies when null.

error.description: Errors block the import; warnings do not.

game_id.description: The game in the collection already linked to this IGDB game.

platform_ids.description: IGDB's ids for the same platforms.

copy_id.description: An owned copy of the game.

added_by_month.description:
Copies added in the last 12 months, by `YYYY-MM` of the purchase date
or, without one, the day the copy was added. Empty months are left out.

added_by_year.description: The same, by `YYYY`, for every year.

conditions.description: Physical copies only, largest first; `None` is not set.

estimated.description: What owned copies would sell for now, per currency, largest first.

most_valuable.description: The copies worth the most, up to five per currency, largest first.

play_days.description: Play in the last 53 weeks, by `YYYY-MM-DD`; days without play are left out.

play_statuses.description: Owned games per play status, in play status order; `None` is not set.

spent.description: What owned copies cost, per currency, largest first.

spent_by_year.description: By the year of the purchase date; copies without one are left out.

stores.description: Largest first; `None` is copies with no store.

unvalued.description: Owned copies without an estimated value.

value_change.description:
Copies priced and valued in the same currency: what they cost against
what they are worth now.

wishlist_value.description: What wanted copies are expected to cost, per currency.

date_format.description: How dates are written, from the app options.

default_currency.description:
Where new prices start: the `currency` option, else the currency of
the copy priced last, else Home Assistant's.

external_services.description: False when the app options keep Memory Card offline.

home_assistant_language.description: Home Assistant's language, for browsers where nobody picked one.

igdb_configured.description: IGDB credentials are set and external services are on.

sensors.description: Whether Home Assistant sensors are being published.

tags.description: Whether Memory Card hears Home Assistant tag scans.

StatusGroup.description: How the backlog page and suggestions treat a play status.

copy_count.description: Copies bought at this store, of any status.

slug.description: Names the store in library links.

Names it in library links. Blank makes one from the name for a new
one and keeps the current one on update.

copy_ids.description: Owned copies of the game that match the filters.

SuggestionFilter.description:
Values inside one filter are OR, filters are AND, and the copy filters
apply to the same owned copy.

device.description:
Device slugs: copies on these devices, or with no device on a platform
one of them plays.

min_local_players.description: Local (same screen) players, release value first, then the game's.

play_status.description: Play status keys. Empty means every status that counts as backlog.

linked.description: Unlinked games matched by exact title.

unmatched.description: Unlinked games without exactly one match; link them by hand.

expires_at.description: When the copy stops waiting for a scan.

keep.description: Games whose title stays; they leave the list until IGDB renames them.

use_igdb.description: Games to rename to their IGDB title.

User.description: The Home Assistant user behind a request.

paid.description: What it cost, when priced in the same currency.

change.description: Estimated minus paid; negative when the copies are worth less.
